recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR source follow-up is needed for FHIR-47909 unless a later work group decision changes DeviceDefinition.outputLanguage semantics.
issue_request: FHIR-47909 was an Applied FHIR-core DeviceDefinition change request with Persuasive with Modification resolution. It asked for a missing value-set binding on languageCode; the final resolution required adding the same binding as Resource.language, renaming the element to outputLanguage, and changing the datatype to code.
initial_application: Commit ff84a09c3e717f77353dd5aa17c79e1a774a1e20 explicitly applied FHIR-47909 by renaming DeviceDefinition.languageCode to DeviceDefinition.outputLanguage, changing CodeableConcept to code, and adding required all-languages plus starter languages bindings. The combined branch already contained that application before this audit.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists devicedefinition=DeviceDefinition, placing the inspected StructureDefinition source in current build scope. OO 2024-09-24 WGM minutes record the same FHIR-47909 motion and 6-0-0 vote. Specific Jira searches found only this issue for the outputLanguage/languageCode terms, and Zulip searches found no directly relevant conflicting discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch because the current authoritative DeviceDefinition source already satisfies the final Jira and meeting decision.
